fact: The Auditor General's information systems audit found the Ministry of Local Government's ELOGREV deployed at only 71 of 2,366 sites since 2014/15, interfaced with URA E-Tax and NIRA but not URSB, PBS or IFMS, with implementation funded by both MoFPED and URA's TREP and overlapping IRAS.
title: Report of the Auditor General on the Ministry of Local Government for the audit year ended December 2024
